weaknesses.point: Cash conversion is poor - very little profit reaches operating cash flow.

opportunities.point: Commissioned capacity should start contributing to revenue.

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Calendar year 2025 witnessed strong growth in automobile sales driven by multiple positive factors such as reduction of GST, income tax reductions, and a more accommodative monetary policy.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Calendar year 2025 witnessed strong growth in automobile sales driven by multiple positive factors such as reduction of GST, income tax reductions, and a more accommodative monetary policy." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 48 -> 75 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 70 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 11 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The fact that the Chinese did not increase prices despite rising raw material prices took away the whole benefit of the anti-dumping duty.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The fact that the Chinese did not increase the price even though raw material prices have increased, have taken away the whole benefit of the anti-dumping duty." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

threats.point: High sulphur prices impacting margins remain a challenge.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Though high sulphur prices which impacts margin remain a challenge." (concall ppt - 2026-02-01)

threats.point: The US imposition of a 50% tariff on imports from India impacted margins for the supplied quantity.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The recent move by the United States to impose a 50% tariff on imports from India has also impacted our margins to the effect of the quantity that we are supplying there." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.
